easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
